text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card (22.9% of 673, expected 4.3%, score 7.84, z 2.76, 23% low-complexity, 63 documented, 1 of 15 below billed, 3 of 38). The headline and the cautious 'inconclusive' leaning fit the evidence. The summary compares billed level with complexity using specific numbers and flags the thin documentation sample. Cited claims fit their sentences (C0008337 has no chronic conditions with M54.50; C0008883 and C0008934 are Z09 only; C0008334 and C0008560 are high MDM). Weaknesses: the claim that the excess holds in every band is only loosely supported, since the 0-condition band is 6.5% against an all-provider share of 2.1%, which is still above but the 'expected' benchmark is not shown per band. The formal next_steps are generic and do not name the specific claims to pull. The 'comparison providers' 12%' wording is fine. The 'weak evidence of cloned or inflated notes' sentence is slightly confusing and loosely tied to the 3 of 38 figure. The rationale is long and somewhat redundant.","problems":["Next steps in the structured list are generic (larger sample, re-screen) and do not name the low-complexity claims; the specific chart request appears only in the rationale text.","'Weak evidence of cloned or inflated notes' is an unclear inference from 3 of 38 notes lacking a lab line; a missing lab line on a claim does not indicate cloning.","The 'every complexity band' claim is made without band-level expected shares; the card gives all-provider shares by band, and the summary does not cite them.","C0008967 is the only below-billed example and its significance is not explained (moderate MDM with no minutes recorded).","Rationale is long, and the 'against that' section partly repeats earlier points."]}
